notes.vehicleDamage: Rockets hurt vehicles (owner, 2026-11-08): twice what they do to anyone else, impact and blast, before a vehicle's armour (the Tank's blasts 1.25). Against the Tank: a side hit 2 x (impact + full splash) x 1.25, so a Rocket Launcher's 160 is 400 (3 to kill it, 4 at an angle; was 6), a Guided Rocket's 165 is 412 (3). Players take the same as before.
notes.group: The extended arsenal: every one fires differently. 8: heavy.
notes.design: Laser-guided: the rocket flies wherever you keep your crosshair. Slow, so steer it round corners.
